items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: So, right after that, I had played with Howard quite a while.

ctx.x: Well, guitar again by that time. And, uh, when, while I was up there is when I bought the bass. See, I always could play some on the bass, but I never did play jobs on the bass, see. So I did, I went, I bought a bass. So I had the bass about, I had the bass about 18 months. So this, uh, uh, boy just passed, uh, Howard, kid Howard? Yes. He said to me, he said, man, I heard you, you got a bass. I said, yes, but I can't play it. He said, oh, I know better than that. He said, I got to have a bass player. I said, I…
About what year was that? Around 1940 or during the Depression?
